prespecification_note: Written and checksum-pinned before the label engine was implemented and before any model curve, Cmax or Tmax was computed. Not blinded: the label was read in full, and two hand calculations were already made and published in docs/LABEL_EXPOSURE_ENGINE.md (4 mg / 860 ng.h/mL = 4.65 L/h; V/F about 50 L from 4.65 L/h and a 7.5 h half-life). The Li 2017 parameters were also read; they are not used here.
not_this: Not validation: a label agreeing with itself says nothing about whether the curve describes patients.
Not an outside-data check; that is Phase 3.1d, with its own locked plan.
Not a dosing recommendation or an exposure prediction for any patient.
question: Can a one-compartment, typical-value curve built from the pomalidomide label by fixed rules reproduce the label's own statements for patients with multiple myeloma, and which parameter set should the engine use?

inputs.regimen: 4 mg orally every 24 h, evaluated at steady state (superposition to steady state; the 21-of-28-day schedule does not change steady-state values within a cycle for a drug with a half-life of a few hours).

model.structure: One compartment, first-order absorption, no lag time, linear; apparent parameters (CL/F, V/F), so F is not needed.
model.steady_state_concentration: C(t) = Dose ka / (V/F (ka - k)) [e^(-k t) / (1 - e^(-k tau)) - e^(-ka t) / (1 - e^(-ka tau))], 0 <= t <= tau, k = (CL/F)/(V/F).
model.ka_rule: ka is not in the label. It is derived from the label Tmax by solving Tmax = ln(ka/k) / (ka - k) for ka > k, using the single-dose Tmax the label reports. Primary: midpoint of the stated range (2.5 h). Sensitivity: each end (2 and 3 h).
model.numerical: Cmax and Tmax at steady state are found on a 0.001 h grid over one dosing interval and checked against the closed-form steady-state Tmax.

parameter_sets.why_this_order: Set A uses the only quantities the label reports for MM patients alone at the labelled dose (steady-state AUC and Cmax); set B uses values pooled across MM and KS.

A_exposure_derived_mm.cl_f: Dose / AUC_tau,ss = 4 mg / 860 ng.h/mL (MM, 4 mg daily, steady state).
A_exposure_derived_mm.v_f: CL/F x t1/2 / ln 2, with t1/2 = 7.5 h (median, patients with MM or KS).

B_stated_pooled.cl_f: Geometric midpoint of the stated range, sqrt(7 x 10) L/h (MM or KS).
B_stated_pooled.v_f: Geometric midpoint of the stated range, sqrt(62 x 138) L (MM or KS).

C1_clearance_vs_exposure.compare: Set CL/F against Dose / AUC_tau,ss (4.651 L/h)

C4_steady_state_auc.compare: Model AUC over 0-24 h at steady state against 860 ng.h/mL

C5_volume_in_stated_range.role: descriptive; the stated range is pooled with KS

C6_tmax.role: descriptive; the label's Tmax is single-dose and set by the ka rule

checks.which_checks_are_informative: For set A, C1, C2 and C4 hold by construction (its CL/F comes from the AUC and its V/F from the half-life), so C3 (steady-state Cmax) is its only informative pass-or-fail check. For set B, all four are informative.

tolerance.rule: A pass-or-fail check passes if model / label is within 0.67 to 1.5 inclusive.
tolerance.why: Wide enough for rounding, medians against means and between-study differences in a label; narrow enough that a twofold disagreement fails.

decision_rule.selection: The engine uses the first set in order_of_preference that passes C1 to C4 under the primary ka. A set that passes under the primary ka but fails under either sensitivity ka is still selected, and the sensitivity result is shown with it.
decision_rule.if_none_passes: Pomalidomide is recorded as not eligible for a label-based curve, with the failing checks.
decision_rule.reporting: Every check for both sets is reported, including for the set not selected.
decision_rule.never: No value is adjusted after seeing results; KS values and Li 2017 values are not used to choose a set.

scenarios.rule: Each label fold-change in the extract is applied as CL/F divided by the AUC fold, to the selected set only, with its quote and study population shown. Scenarios are not combined. Scenarios from healthy-subject studies are labelled as such.
scenarios.not_checked_here: Scenarios are carried into the engine, not tested; no outside data for them are in hand.
